relations.quote: The H2D supports a maximum of 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT connected simultaneously, a total of 12 units with 24 slots.
The H2D supports a maximum of 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT connected simultaneously, a total of 12 units with 24 slots.
The first-generation AMS has been confirmed to have full plug-and-play compatibility and can be used with the H2D for multi-color printing, but it does not support the AMS drying function.
relations.condition: First-generation AMS: plug-and-play for multi-colour printing; the AMS drying function is not supported

relations.quote: Due to the fundamental differences in the feeding mechanism and buffering structure, the H2D does not support the AMS lite.
* To connect more than 2 AMS(including AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT), a 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter (FAZ013-N) is needed.
relations.condition: Only to connect more than 2 AMS units (AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT)

relations.target_label: external power adapter (for AMS 2 Pro used for drying)
relations.locator: Packing list › note after 'Other H2D AMS Combo options'
relations.quote: When the H2D is used with more than one AMS 2 Pro — some for multi-color printing and others for filament drying — the AMS 2 Pro units used for drying require an external power adapter
relations.condition: Only when more than one AMS 2 Pro is used and some of them dry filament while others print
